usedFor: NeetoCal holds bookings and Kylas CRM holds leads, so “New Booking” can run “Create or Update Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Booking” in NeetoCal, then “Create or Update Lead” in Kylas CRM
bestTemplate.why: Each booking becomes a lead, and a duplicate phone or email is updated or skipped instead of doubled.

watchOut: “Delete Lead” also runs from “New Booking” in this pair, so never point a booking at it.
